indications.name: Induction of general anesthesia in adults undergoing surgery
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-21: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of CYPSEDO (cipepofol) injection for induction of general anesthesia in adults undergoing surgery.
